notes.title: Introducing the Goathernet Update!
notes.notes:
Dear goatified players,

It's been a goat time! How are you all doing? We've been busy goating around the servers to bring you the newest addition to the Goat of Duty cinematic universe. Introducing the Goathernet Update!

What's new in the Goathernet Update (most commonly known as 0.5.1 update)?


 HUGE news: There's a new and improved network arbitrage in place! This means that there won't be lag differences between client and server players (those joining the matches, and those hosting them). Now, shooting is waaaay more responsive and satisfying for all the bullet weapons (which excludes Fus Ro Beh because it only shoots air... special, dragonborn air). The experience of playing Goat of Duty will now be better for everygoat!
 There's no more pushback while shooting the Nailgun. NAIL THEM. NAIL THEM ALL.
 We've adjusted the mouth of the flamethrower to have a more streamlined opening, thus allowing you to see better where you shoot at! We care for your vision.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34981763/104a4e2269a89762158314e8a8f776ceac8409f5.gif

Thanosed bugs

 Fixed a tremendous drop in performance after playing several consecutive matches. The responsible: an infamous memory leak, now eradicated.
 We fixed the bug that was resetting goat points in some cases. We truly apologize to those affected by this issue. We value your time playing Goat of Duty and your effort in climbing the leaderboards to become the G.O.A.T.
 Corrected a goat point issue consisting of showing 0 points for some players in the scoreboard and the lobby. That was a lie.
 Fixed a spawn in mid-air bug that was randomly spawning some goats in mid-air, sometimes even outside of the map. IT'S RAINING GOATS. HALLELUJAH, IT'S RAINING GOATS.
 Goat rid of a random crash while idling in the main menu.
 Fixed the missing chart and timer in the training celebration screen. Now they are not missing. They are unmissing.
 Increased particle performance in the main menu. Their latest concert wasn't as good, so we practiced with them, thus becoming a truly fine band! (sorry)
 A random crash during Markhor tag is now fixed. Thank GoD.
 Other minor, mysterious fixes...

ONE MORE THING!

This new update is focused on preparing the servers for a new influx of goats... So arm up and stretch your legs on the goatfield, 'cause something's gonna happen really soon!

Stay safe, goaties.

The 34 Big Things & Raiser Games Teams.

notes.title: Participate in a Short, 3-min Survey Before the Next Big Update!
notes.notes:
Dear badass goats,

Thank you for your participation in our last survey! Your insightful feedback is helping us shape the future of Goat of Duty.

This time, we are coming back to ask for your participation in a brief, 3 min survey to complement our results. This last survey is aimed to understand which kind of content do you want to see integrated into Goat of Duty, so we can work on it during the following months. That's why your answers mean a lot to us!

Participate in the survey by clicking right here

You can also expect a big update really soon, so stay tuned to know when and what we are going to introduce next in Goat of Duty.

Thank you for your support during these exciting months. We cannot wait to show you what we have in store for Goat of Duty.

May the goats be ever in your favor

notes.title: THANKS for your feedback, goats! The Community Update is now here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34981763/ade29ebcf2cd90ce7fc3184d9e0e39af2ddac806.jpg

Hello, our beautiful goats!

Your favourite horn-based multiplayer shooter today sees the launch of a massive ‘Community Update’, featuring scores of new goatures suggested by all of your feedback and bringing a fresh competitive element to play.

Most notably, this update brings in a ranking system and global/per game mode leaderboards to add an extra layer of competition to proceedings. You will now receive GOAT Points at the end of each encounter based on the skill you demonstrated in play. GOAT Scores for each mode are then combined to provide a Global GOAT Score, enabling you to see just the comparison to the world’s best goat! (is that you?)

And hold your horses...I mean, goats, as there are new more features included in the update, based on your precious feedback!
 Private Matches - You can now create and invite your friends in a private match.
 Sound Occlusion - Play benefits from more believable and realistic sounds.
 Joining an ongoing match will give you now five seconds of freecam before joining the game so you can early understand the game mode and map you're taking on.
 Gentle host disconnection - You won't be no more kicked to main menu but gentle accompanied to the celebration screen.
 Find match feature.
 Maps and weapons optimisations and improvements.
 Various bug fixes. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34981763/ea31d089391d08288be66f086a6979d636f54f18.jpg

You will be able to boost your GOAT Score if, in team-based modes, you are part of the winning team, or in other modes if you make it onto the podium. But, be careful, cause if you disconnect before the end of the match, you will also lose points!

There are four main factors you shall keep in mind for your final GOAT points at the end of each game:
 How many kills you scored: the more you kill other players, the more points you gain.
 How many times you were killed: you lose points the more times you die.
 How much of the match you actually played (to balance out late goaters).
 Keep an eye on the match's average GOAT score: You will gain more points by killing a more experienced player, while getting killed by ‘rookies’ will lose more points. 
 (In Markhor games, only kills made by the Markhor count towards GOAT score.)

And last but not least, you can take a look at the updated roadmap (goatmap?) to see what's coming next... Let's keep goatting around!
